references.caption: Linear app showing the My Issues page with the assigned tab selected
references.use: Dark workspace sidebar, My issues tabs and grouped issue identifiers/titles. Assigned and Created are backed by existing relations; other tabs and advanced curation are omitted. Current rows add synthetic brand avatars; accessible labels retain the stored names.

references.caption: Linear issue assignment and delegation
references.use: Issue body with right-hand Properties, status, priority, assignee and team. One assignee or No assignee. Delegation and expanded production permission rules are outside this pack scope.
Team-specific workflow status and standard priority labels. No manual archive control because current official help says archiving is automatic only.
Issue title/description and team context; the browser reads these fields and does not introduce a creation form.
Existing issueUpdate action; the browser shares its workspace, same-team state and assignee refusals.

workflow.identity: Existing settings-door user/password and existing linear_session browser session; API Authorization remains separate.
workflow.entry: GET / then sign in, redirect to the stored organization's first nonarchived team by name, or its empty workspace.
workflow.teamList: GET /{urlKey}/team/{key}/all: stored nonarchived team issues, grouped by workflow state; q filters the current view by title or identifier.
workflow.myIssues: GET /{urlKey}/my-issues/assigned: stored assignee relation grouped by status; /created: stored creator relation ordered by creation date. Advanced production curation is omitted.
workflow.issueDetail: GET /{urlKey}/issue/{identifier}: stored title, Markdown description, state, priority, assignee, team, dates and comments.
workflow.mutation: POST issue detail with action=update: status and assignee call the shared existing issueUpdate action and redirect to a fresh stored-row GET.
